changelog: Dev build v840 - CSM menu transition parity: the overlay used to appear and disappear with no animation at all. It now uses CloudStream's own settings transition - the host graph declares enterAnim=@anim/enter_anim with exitAnim=@anim/exit_anim and reuses that same pair for popEnter/popExit - resolved from the host resources and applied to both overlay transactions, failing closed when they cannot be resolved. Fixed: on Android TV the CSM settings page is full width. The Compose renderer capped its content column at 600dp and centred it, which made the CSM page narrower than CloudStream's own settings on a TV; the cap now applies only when the device is not a television. Tests: 6 new parity tests for TV detection/width and the transition slots. This dev build aggregates all current unpublished source in the shared CSM tree and is not an isolated patch.
message: Dev build v840 - CSM settings open/close animation parity; full-width CSM page on TV
